title: Injection-safe search
skill: Name every input path and the exact escaping

good: Fix SQL injection in users/store.py. find_by_email: use "... WHERE email = ?" with (email,). search_users(name): name = name.strip(); if empty return []; escape the text by replacing \ with \\, then % with \% and _ with \_, add % at the end (prefix match); run "SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY name COLLATE NOCASE, id" with that pattern as the only parameter; keep returning [dict(row) ...]. No user text may appear in any SQL string. Only change users/store.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: search_users is open to SQL injection. Fix it.
